checks.title: A spawned child runs and reports back: the parent calls spawn_sub_agent and the child's submitted payload reaches the parent
Children are isolated and factory built: each child owns its data directory and save file, and an AgentFactory constructs it
Fleet visibility and teardown: agents_status lists a live child, and shutdown_agent removes it
join_agents blocks until every listed child finishes, then returns each child's result
Agents address their parent and the user: send_message_to_parent blocks the child, respond_to_parent_message resumes it with a reply that carries its sender's address
A message arriving during a slow tool wakes the agent before that tool finishes, and the backgrounded tool's result still arrives
A child that goes idle without submitting is woken rather than treated as finished, and after three wakes it escalates to its parent
